title: Reachability-Informed Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Impulse Interplanetary Transfers
summary: Reinforcement learning offers the prospect of a reusable sequential decision-making mechanism for spacecraft trajectory design, motivating policy interfaces that connect learned decisions to the underlying maneuver geometry. This paper develops Reachability Analysis-Informed Reinforcement Learning (RARL) for deterministic multi-impulse interplanetary transfers, placing intermediate waypoint selection at the center of the learned decision process.
